problems.statement_en: Consider the sequence (cn): c1 = a1 + a2 + · · ·+ a8, c2 = a2 1 + a2 2 + · · ·+ a2 8, . . . . . . . . . . . . cn = an 1 + an 2 + · · ·+ an 8, . . . . . . . . . . . . where a1,a2, . . . ,a8 are real numbers, not all equal to zero. Given that among the numbers of the sequence (cn) there are infinitely many equal to zero, determine all the values of n for which cn = 0. (Soviet Union)
